briefTitle: Phase 1a and Phase 2 Study for Safety, Preliminary Efficacy, PK and PD of ST-067

typedChecks.sourceText: Male and female patients aged ≥18 years
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Male and female patients aged ≥18 years

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of advanced/metastatic solid tumor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Broad solid tumor trial with multiple cohorts and phase-dependent specifications.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has at least 1 measurable lesion per RECIST 1.1 criteria which has not been biopsied or received prior irradiation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has an accessible tumor for biopsy pre- and on-treatment (mandatory).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or accessibility for biopsy is a procedural requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known symptomatic brain metastases requiring >10 mg/day of prednisolone or equivalent
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic CNS disease with steroid thresholds is not a clean typed brain_mets rule.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Presence of known active CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis. Subjects with previously treated brain metastases may participate provided they are radiologically stable, i.e., without evidence of progression for at least 4 weeks by repeat imaging, clinically stable, and without requirement of steroid treatment for at least 14 days prior to first dose of study treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Combines active CNS exclusion with specific stability and steroid washout windows for treated metastases.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects with any chemistry or hematology laboratory values that are ≥Grade 2
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General Grade 2 or higher lab abnormality exclusion is not a single specific lab cutoff kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Have histologically or cytologically confirmed diagnosis of advanced/metastatic solid tumor
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The trial is a basket study for solid tumors, including NSCLC as one of many options across phases with specific phase-dependent mutation exclusions, rather than restricted solely to NSCLC stage definitions.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has at least 1 measurable lesion per RECIST 1.1 criteria which has not been biopsied or received prior irradiation
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Has an accessible tumor for biopsy pre- and on-treatment (mandatory).
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Willingness or ability to undergo a biopsy procedure is a subjective requirement, not a typed check.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Known symptomatic brain metastases requiring >10 mg/day of prednisolone or equivalent
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Symptomatic CNS disease with a steroid dose threshold is not a clean typed brain_mets status.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Presence of known active CNS metastases and/or carcinomatous meningitis. Subjects with previously treated brain metastases may participate provided they are radiologically stable, i.e., without evidence of progression for at least 4 weeks by repeat imaging, clinically stable, and without requirement of steroid treatment for at least 14 days prior to first dose of study treatment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: This exclusion applies only to Phase 1 combination therapy and involves stability and steroid washout windows.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Subjects with any chemistry or hematology laboratory values that are ≥Grade 2
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General CTCAE Grade 2 laboratory cutoffs across multiple unspecified panels cannot be mapped to a single typed lab check.
